identifier.description: Crisp token identifier, stored as a credential secret and sent as the HTTP Basic username.

key.description: Crisp token secret key, stored as a credential secret and sent as the HTTP Basic password.

website_id.description: Crisp workspace/website identifier used to scope every Wave 1 request.

token_tier.description: Crisp token tier sent as X-Crisp-Tier; website is the default documented website-token tier.

base_url.description: Crisp API origin override for approved tests or proxies; the bundle adds the documented /v1 path.

page_number.description: Positive numbered provider page for page-addressed Crisp list resources; defaults to 1.

session_id.description: Conversation session identifier required by conversation-scoped reads.

spam_id.description: Spam conversation identifier required by the spam-content read.

fingerprint.description: Message fingerprint required by the single-message read.

original_id.description: Original-message identifier required by the original-message read.
